contents.github.copilot.config.inlineEdits.xtabPr:
Advanced model configuration untuk the next edit suggestions xtab provider. Optional `reasoningEffort` sends `reasoning_effort` dan accepts `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, atau `max`; supported levels depend on the model. Optional `maxCompletionTokens` is a positive integer budget untuk completion tokens, including reasoning tokens, dan sends `max_completion_tokens` instead of `max_tokens`. When `github.copilot.chat.advanced.inlineEdits.xtabProvider.usePrediction` is true, both `useMaxTokens` dan `maxCompletionTokens` are ignored dan neither token limit is sent. Otherwise, pengaturan `github.copilot.chat.advanced.inlineEdits.xtabProvider.useMaxTokens` to false suppresses both token limits. Omitting these fields preserves existing request behavior. untuk example: `{ "modelName": "your-model", "includeTagsInCurrentFile": false, "reasoningEffort": "low", "maxCompletionTokens": 8192 }`. The same fields are supported in the experiment-driven `modelConfigurationString` dan `defaultModelConfigurationString` JSON strings.

**Note**: This is an advanced pengaturan.
Scaffold a new ruang kerja in VS Code

contents.github.copilot.config.anthropic.contextE:
pilih the context editing mode untuk Anthropic models. Automatically manages conversation context as it grows, helping optimize costs dan stay within context jendela limits.

- `off`: Context editing is dinonaktifkan.
- `clear-thinking`: Clears thinking blocks while preserving alat uses.
- `clear-tooluse`: Clears alat uses while preserving thinking blocks.
- `clear-both`: Clears both thinking blocks dan alat uses.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature. Context editing may cause additional cache rewrites. aktifkan dengan caution.
contents.github.copilot.config.anthropic.promptCa:
Use the extended (1 hour) prompt cache TTL on alat dan system blocks untuk the Anthropic Messages API. diterapkan to Claude Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7 dan Sonnet 4.5/4.6 variants; other models keep the bawaan 5 minute TTL even when this pengaturan is diaktifkan.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature. Only the main agen conversation is eligible — inline chat, terminal chat, notebook chat, dan subagent requests are excluded.

Also extend the 1 hour prompt cache TTL to message-level breakpoints. Requires `chat.anthropic.promptCaching.extendedTtl` to be diaktifkan; has no effect on its own.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature.
contents.github.copilot.config.modelCapabilityOve:
Per-model capability overrides keyed oleh model id, intended untuk evaluating preview dan tenanted models against an existing model's capability profile. untuk each model id, declare an aliased `family` atau set `thinkingInHistory` to control replay of thinking dari earlier user turns untuk Chat Completions models. pengaturan `family` to a known production family (e.g. `"claude-opus-4.7"`) makes the model receive that family's full capability profile — Anthropic family detection, latest Opus prompt, multi-ganti alat, alat cari, context editing, extended cache TTL — tanpa a code change.

**Note**: This is an advanced pengaturan untuk evaluation use; it is not intended untuk regular end-user configuration.
contents.github.copilot.config.thinkingInHistory: Apakah the Chat Completions model accepts thinking replayed dari earlier user turns. diaktifkan secara bawaan untuk Kimi K3. aktifkan only untuk models that support preserved thinking.
contents.github.copilot.config.useResponsesApi:
Use the Responses API instead of the Chat Completions API when supported. Enables reasoning dan reasoning summaries.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature that is not yet activated untuk all users.

**Important**: untuk Custom Endpoint models, the API type is independent of this pengaturan dan is determined per-model via the `apiType` property, atau inferred dari the `url` path when omitted.

**Note**: untuk bring-your-own-key models, explicit prompt caching is only used when this pengaturan is explicitly diaktifkan, because some gateways do not forward the cache breakpoint markers.

contents.github.copilot.config.anthropic.tools.we:
Aktifkan Anthropic's native web cari alat untuk BYOK Claude models. When diaktifkan, allows Claude to cari the web untuk saat ini information. 

**Note**: This is an experimental feature only available untuk BYOK Anthropic Claude models.
Maximum number of web searches allowed per request. Valid range is 1 to 20. Prevents excessive API calls within a single interaction. If Claude exceeds this limit, the response returns an error.

Daftar domains to restrict web cari results to (e.g., `["example.com", "docs.example.com"]`). Domains should not include the HTTP/HTTPS scheme. Subdomains are automatically included. Cannot be used together dengan `#github.copilot.chat.anthropic.tools.websearch.blockedDomains#`; mengonfigurasi both will cause web cari requests to fail.

Daftar domains to exclude dari web cari results (e.g., `["untrustedsource.com"]`). Domains should not include the HTTP/HTTPS scheme. Subdomains are automatically excluded. Cannot be used together dengan `#github.copilot.chat.anthropic.tools.websearch.allowedDomains#`; mengonfigurasi both will cause web cari requests to fail.

User location untuk personalizing web cari results based on geographic context. All fields (city, region, country, timezone) are optional. Example: `{"city": "San Francisco", "region": "California", "country": "US", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles"}`

contents.copilot.tools.executionSubagent.descript: Launch an execution-focused subagent that runs one atau more terminal commands to accomplish a task. This subagent is powered oleh Google's Gemini-3-Flash model. It is designed to pilih an efficient summary of the terminal outputs to return to the main agen context.
Aktifkan the ekstensi-native Execution Subagent alat in Copilot Chat. The Execution Subagent is designed to jalankan terminal commands to accomplish an execution-based task. It is powered oleh Google's Gemini-3-Flash model. The separate Copilot runtime implementation in agen Host sesi is controlled oleh `#chat.agentHost.copilot.executionSubagent.enabled#`.
Use the agentic proxy endpoint untuk the execution subagent.
The model to use untuk the Execution Subagent alat in Copilot Chat. When useAgenticProxy is diaktifkan, defaults to 'exec-subagent-router-a'. Otherwise defaults to gemini-3-flash.

contents.github.copilot.session.providerDescripti: Delegate tasks to the GitHub Copilot coding agen. The agen iterates via chat dan works asynchronously in the cloud to implement changes dan pull requests as needed.
